== Update April 7, 2026 ==

Hotfix:
* Fixed an issue with the dungeon chest rewards were scaling improperly. The chest rewards now scale progressively better as the dungeon gets more difficult.
* Fixed an issue where the dungeon chest could incorrectly drop dyes that had different sell prices preventing stacking.
* Updated the Ascalon Warhorn to spawn guards at summoner’s level -5. Min level 5, max level 15.
* Closed the gates on Forsaken Tunnels 3 to prevent unintended chest farming.
* Fixed Devona’s starting hammer to have stats.
